runs.developer_explanation: This method appends to a String using the + operator within a loop, causing a new String to be created on each iteration. Over many iterations the cost grows quadratically. Replace the loop with a StringBuilder to build the string efficiently and avoid this overhead.

This omission directly allows loaded classes to bypass the systemwide policy, creating a clear security risk.

Add a call to the superclass method to ensure classes honor the intended permissions.

findings.message: Equals checks for incompatible operand

This can make equality asymmetric: a JettyHttpExchange may consider a delegate equal, while the delegate will consider the exchange not equal. findings.message: Comparison of String parameter using == or !=

This will incorrectly return false for separate strings that have the same characters ignoring case. Replace the comparison with 's1.equalsIgnoreCase(s2)' (or a similar content‑based method) to ensure proper behavior.
